about: Integrations that feed Glass Panes widgets, shown in the builder's Add panel and on docs/works-with.md. Each entry was checked against the integration's own page (Nov 18, 2026; radar entries re-checked the same day). source: core (built into Home Assistant) or hacs.

sports.name: Team Tracker
sports.gives: one sensor per team: live score, opponent and the next game

news.name: Feedreader
news.gives: an event entity per RSS or Atom feed

image.name: Generic Camera
image.gives: a camera from any picture address

weather.name: Met.no
weather.gives: a weather entity with a forecast, anywhere in the world

calendar_agenda.name: Local Calendar
calendar_agenda.gives: a calendar kept in Home Assistant

todo_list.name: Local To-do
todo_list.gives: a to-do list kept in Home Assistant

now_playing.name: Music Assistant
now_playing.gives: a media player for every speaker it finds, including the mirror's own

people.name: Home Assistant Companion app
people.gives: a phone's location for each person

lights_summary.name: Group
lights_summary.gives: a light group, so one widget covers a room

radar.name: Environment Canada
radar.gives: a radar map camera, rain, snow or precipitation type (Canada; switch the camera entity on first)

radar.name: Buienradar
radar.gives: a rain radar camera (Netherlands and Belgium; switch the camera entity on first)

radar.name: Generic Camera
radar.gives: a camera from any picture address, such as your weather service's radar image (a still image URL)
